digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool search configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use while cheaper alternatives like grep are immediately available, creating friction asymmetry.
The ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable is the only available control for tool deferral and is all-or-nothing; no per-tool or per-MCP-server non-deferral setting exists.
Loading all Serena tool schemas (~25k tokens minimum when only Serena is connected, ~64k with 4 MCP servers) is required to make symbol tools resident since per-tool selectivity is not implementable.

A tracked .claude/settings.json file must be created with appropriate ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH configuration, with .gitignore negation to allow tracking only that file while keeping .claude/ directory otherwise ignored.
